**Overview**  
  

We offer generous relocation support to help make your transition as seamless as possible.

At Lutron, we are transforming how people experience light through intelligent, connected lighting devices and systems. We are looking for extraordinary and world-class people that are outstanding in both strategic and practical areas.  As a Principal Data Scientist, you will deliver impact through data science, ML, and AI by working with the functional teams to develop and execute the technical vision for data science and AI across the company, and you will help to build the organization.  You will lead the most complex and high-impact initiatives, influence company-wide strategy, and establish standards and foundational capabilities that enable Lutron’s next generation of intelligent products and services.

  
**Responsibilities**  
  

* Execute multi-year, company-wide data science and AI initiatives with significant business and product impact.  Move the company forward and show progress.
* Apply your problem-solving skills to address highly complex, ambiguous problems that span multiple domains and organizations
* Architect and deploy scalable machine learning and AI systems that serve as foundational platforms for multiple teams
* Partner with senior engineering, product, and business leaders to shape and execute Lutron’s Data & AI strategy
* Identify, evaluate, and incubate emerging technologies such as generative AI, reinforcement learning, and edge AI
* Establish best practices and standards for MLOps, responsible AI, model governance, and technical excellence
* Mentor and develop senior and staff-level data scientists and technical leaders
* Represent Lutron as a technical authority in data science and AI, both internally and externally
* Drive creation of reusable frameworks, platforms, and intellectual property

  
**Qualifications**  
  

* PhD  degree in a STEM field or MS in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Math or related engineering discipline
* Minimum, cumulative GPA of 3.00 for all degrees earned
* 12+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, and AI with sustained, enterprise-level impact
* Proven leadership track record leading teams and projects, coordinating across functions, and driving execution from concept through delivery.
* Deep expertise in advanced machine learning, AI systems, and large-scale production deployments
* Proven ability to influence strategy and technical direction across multiple organizations
* Exceptional communication skills, including executive-level technical storytelling
* Proficiency in Python, R, or Scala, and deep experience with modern ML frameworks and cloud platforms
* Expert in large-scale cloud deployment of ML/AI models
* Expert in MLOps
* You are authorized to work in the U.S. and will not require Lutron to sponsor you for any work visa, such as an H-1B, either immediately or at any time in the future. Lutron does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position

**Desired Qualifications**

* Recognized thought leadership in applied data science or AI
* Background in IoT, embedded systems, or intelligent devices
* Experience contributing to patents, publications, or industry standards

For candidates in the following locations, the expected base pay ranges are:

**Boston, MA:** $175,000-$200,000

Compensation in other U.S. locations will vary based on market data. Lutron's employee benefits include 401k match, health, dental, and life insurance, paid vacation (amount based on tenure with the company), flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement programs. 

We offer generous relocation support to help make your transition as seamless as possible.

* * *

Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Our company has cultivated a reputation of unsurpassed quality, a broad range of technologies and product offerings, and a strong commitment to servicing our worldwide customers. This has allowed the company to invest in developing new technologies and services, expand our technical capabilities and global presence, and to find and retain the best talent.  Build your career with Lutron where you will enjoy competitive compensation and benefits while exploring many options for continued growth and education. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at  [www.lutron.com](http://www.lutron.com/).

*Lutron Electronics is an Equal Opportunity – Affirmative Action – Employer. We welcome qualified, motivated applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics*

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

Position: Data Scientist

Location: Etters, PA

Amphenol High Speed Products Group is the market leader for high-speed, high-bandwidth electrical connectors, cables, and systems for the Datacom/Telecom market (AI, ML, GPUs, Servers, Switches, Routers, Storage). Our products help to enable the artificial intelligence revolution by helping major Tier 1 Hyperscale Data Centers, their OEMs and break-out AI customers to innovate globally. Our global headquarters is in Nashua, NH and we have engineering, sales, and manufacturing locations globally. We are currently seeking a Data Scientist to join our engineering team.

The Data Scientist will apply statistical modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytics to engineering data. Working alongside data analysts and software engineers, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems and turn data into insight that drives engineering decisions.

• Design and build statistical and machine learning models to solve engineering problems, such as predicting failures, optimizing processes, or identifying trends

• Partner with engineering stakeholders to translate open-ended questions into well-scoped analytical projects

• Explore and analyze large, complex datasets to uncover patterns and insights

• Collaborate with data analysts and software engineers to productionize models and integrate them into existing systems and workflows

• Communicate findings, methodologies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

A good candidate should have 3+ years of experience in a data science or applied statistics role.

• Comfort working with messy, real-world data, including cleaning, reconciling, and validating across multiple sources

• Strong communication skills, able to explain complex methodologies to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, or similar) for model development

Do you want your work to help researchers solve humanity’s biggest challenges?
At Elsevier, data science is not about building models for the sake of building models. It is about advancing scientific discovery, improving healthcare outcomes, and helping researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions unlock knowledge that can improve lives around the world.
Every day, millions of scientists rely on our products to discover evidence, connect ideas, validate findings, and advance research. As a Data Scientist, your work will directly contribute to the tools and technologies that help accelerate human progress.

As part of a growing team of Data Scientists, you will take on some of the hardest problems in science. This team is building intelligent systems that can reason across scientific publications, research data, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, taxonomies, citations, and content spanning every scientific discipline.

As a Data Scientist at Elsevier, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that power knowledge discovery across the global research ecosystem. You will work with one of the world's richest collections of scientific information, including publications, citations, research datasets, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multidisciplinary content spanning every scientific field.

+ Design and deploy machine learning, NLP, and generative AI solutions that help researchers discover, understand, and apply scientific knowledge.

+ Create robust evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, relevance, trustworthiness, and user impact.
+ Build scalable data pipelines and machine learning workflows that support experimentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
+ Apply the appropriate combination of classical machine learning, deep learning, retrieval, and generative AI techniques to solve complex scientific problems.
+ Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, analytics, and domain experts to transform ambiguous challenges into practical solutions.

+ Continuously improve the capabilities, performance, and real-world value of AI systems that support scientific discovery.

+ Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
+ Extensive Python programming skills and experience building production-quality data science solutions.
+ Experience with machine learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, feature engineering, and performance optimization.
+ Experience working with large-scale structured, semi-structured, or unstructured datasets.
+ Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and generative AI.
+ Familiarity with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools.
+ Experience evaluating AI outputs and improving model quality, reliability, and business impact.
+ Ability to translate complex problems into measurable, data-driven solutions.
+ A genuine passion for advancing science, improving access to knowledge, and using AI to create meaningful real-world impact.
